name: CPP_87_virtual_dtor_flow
description: C++ virtual destructors (spec 016), POSITIVE: `Base* p = new Derived(); p->set(source()); delete p;` with `virtual ~Base` and `~Derived(){ sink(v); }`. The virtual destructor makes `delete p` run the dynamic type's chain (~Derived then ~Base), and ~Derived sinks the tainted member. Before spec 016 `delete` was a no-op (s=none d=flow soundness-disagree); now CTADL models it as a CHA call over the subtree destructors, capturing the flow. s=flow d=flow agree.
